THE MATTER WAS CALLED TWICE BECAUSE OF THE LATE ARRIVAL OF MS. KENNEY TO COURT AND COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF IS NO LONGER PRESENT. THE COURT ADVISED DEFENDANT TO COME TO COURT ON TIME AND TO GIVE NOTICE TO THE OTHER SIDE IF SHE WISH TO CONTEST THE TENTATIVE RULING. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
